description: Defines an interface for kernel syscalls and a wrapper class for making syscalls with retry logic, primarily used for testing and platform abstraction.

classes.name: KernelInterface
classes.description: Abstract class defining virtual methods for kernel syscalls, enabling mocking and platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: ParametrizedKernel
classes.description: Template class implementing KernelInterface, wrapping syscall functions with retry logic using a Runner.

classes.name: DefaultKernelRunner
classes.description: Default implementation of a runner that executes syscall functions without additional logic.

methods.name: SyscallRetryOnError
methods.description: Retries a syscall on error, specifically on EINTR, until success or a different error occurs.

methods.name: SyscallRetry
methods.description: Retries a syscall until success or error, using SyscallRetryOnError with a default error value.
